blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Biomedical machine learning papers often compress model performance into one headline number. That number can look like a property of the model even when it depends strongly on how the benchmark was evaluated. We study this problem on the widely used Kermany pediatric chest radiograph dataset using nine image classifiers and a controlled evaluation protocol. Under the same protocol, the eight pretrained backbones differ by only 0.026 AUROC. In contrast, changing whether the backbone is frozen or fine tuned changes AUROC by 0.044 on average, and changing the decision threshold changes balanced accuracy by 0.090 on average. The official test split is also measurably different from the training pool: a partition classifier distinguishes them at AUC 0.697, rising to 0.898 for normal radiographs. Most strikingly, a classifier using only file properties, with no image anatomy, reaches 0.992 balanced accuracy within the training pool but falls to 0.496 on the official test split. Validation fitted thresholds and calibration also transfer imperfectly. These results show that a high benchmark score can support different conclusions when the split, training policy, threshold, metric, calibration, and uncertainty are not communicated with it. We end with a seven item reporting recommendation in which each item is tied to an effect measured in the study.
blocks.zh: 生物医学机器学习论文经常将模型性能压缩成一个标题数字. 这个数字可能看起来像模型的一个属性,即使它在很大程度上取决于如何评价基准。 我们在广泛使用的Kermany儿科胸腔辐射数据集上研究这个问题,使用9个图像分类器和受控评价协议. 根据同一协议,八个预训骨干只差0.026 AUROC. 相比之下,改变主干线是冷冻还是微调使AUROC平均变化0.044,改变决定阈值则平均变化0.090的平衡精度. 官方的测试分拆也与训练池有相当大的不同:一个分区分类器在AUC 0.697中将其区分开来,正常的射电图则上升到0.898. 最引人注目的是,一个只使用文件属性的分类器,没有图像解剖学,在训练池内达到0.992的平衡精度,但在正式测试拆分时降至0.496. 校准的校准也符合阈值和校准。 这些结果表明,如果与分数、培训政策、阈值、计量、校准和不确定性不沟通,高基准分数可以支持不同的结论。 最后,我们提出七个项目报告建议,每个项目都与研究报告中衡量的效果挂钩。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A biomedical machine learning paper is often remembered by one number. A reader may remember 98% accuracy or 0.97 AUROC long after the details of the experiment are forgotten. That number can then appear in related work, presentations, grant proposals, or discussions of clinical readiness. The problem is that the number is usually read as a property of the model, even though it also depends on how the model was evaluated.

blocks.en: We study the pediatric chest radiograph dataset released by Kermany et al. ( Kermany et al., 2018 ) . It is a useful case because it is public, small enough for controlled experiments, widely reused, and distributed with a fixed train and test split. Published studies report high performance on this corpus, often under evaluation setups that are not directly comparable ( Stephen et al., 2019 ; Kundu et al., 2021 ; Siddiqi and Javaid, 2024 ) . Some preserve the official test split, while others pool the corpus and create a new split. Some freeze a pretrained backbone, while others fine tune it. Threshold selection and calibration are often not reported. These are exactly the choices represented by Eq. 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们研究了克尔曼尼等人发布的儿科胸腔放射图数据集. (Kermany等人,2018年). 这是一个有用的案例,因为它是公开的,小到足以进行有控制的实验,被广泛再利用,并用固定的火车和测试分拆分配. 出版的研究表明,有关这一文书的绩效很高,经常受到无法直接比较的评价(Stephen等人,2019年;Kundu等人,2021年;Siddiqi和Javaid,2024年)。 一些人保留了官方的测试拆分,而另一些人则集中了程序书并创造了新的拆分. 一些人冻结了预先训练的骨干,而另一些人则调整得很好. 门槛选择和校准往往没有报告。 这些正是Eq.2所代表的选择。

blocks.en: First, under one fixed protocol, the eight pretrained backbones differ by only 0.026 AUROC, while changing whether the backbone is frozen or fine tuned changes AUROC by 0.044 on average and as much as 0.103. Second, the official test split is measurably different from the training pool. A partition classifier distinguishes the two at AUC 0.697, rising to 0.898 for normal radiographs. Third, a model that uses only file properties and no anatomy reaches 0.992 balanced accuracy within the training pool but only 0.496 on the official test split. This makes the risk of pooling and randomly re-splitting the corpus concrete. Fourth, thresholds and calibration fitted on validation data do not fully transfer to the official test distribution. These results are summarized in Table 2 and developed in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 首先,在一个固定协议下,8个预训骨干只差0.026 AUROC,同时改变骨干是冷冻还是精细调制,平均变化0.044,高达0.103. 第二,正式的试题分拆与训练池差别很大. 一个分区分类器在AUC 0.697中将两者区分开来,正常的射电图则上升至0.898. 第三,一个只使用文件属性且没有解剖学的模型在训练池内达到0.992平衡精度,但在正式测试分时只有0.496. 这使得集合和随机重分保单的风险变得具体化. 第四,在验证数据上安装的阈值和校准不完全转入正式测试分布. 表2概述了这些结果,并在第4节中作了阐述。

blocks.en: Our contribution is not a new pneumonia classifier and not a claim that this benchmark is unusable. It is a controlled case study of how the same biomedical benchmark can support different stories when the evaluation protocol is hidden. We connect each communication recommendation to a measured effect, rather than presenting a generic checklist. This directly addresses the gap between technical ML results and the claims that readers, clinicians, reviewers, and policymakers may take from them. Existing reporting guidance such as TRIPOD+AI already asks for many of these details ( Collins et al., 2024 ) ; our goal is to show, with measured examples, why those details change the meaning of the result.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献不是新的肺炎分类法,也不是声称这一基准无法使用。 它是一个可控制的案例研究,研究当评价协议被隐藏时,同样的生物医学基准如何能够支持不同的故事. 我们把每一项来文建议都与某种程度的效果联系起来,而不是提出一个通用清单。 这直接解决了技术性的ML结果与读者、临床医生、审查者和决策者可能从中获取的主张之间的差距。 现有的报告指南,如TRIPOD+AI,已经要求提供许多这些细节(Collins等人,2024年),我们的目标是用衡量的例子说明这些细节为何改变结果的含义。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: High performance on a medical imaging dataset does not by itself show that a model learned clinically meaningful evidence. Models can exploit acquisition patterns, hospital identity, image processing, text markers, or other dataset specific features that correlate with the label but do not transfer to a new setting ( Zech et al., 2018 ; DeGrave et al., 2021 ) . Shortcut learning is a broader machine learning problem in which a predictor uses an easy correlated feature instead of the mechanism the task is intended to measure ( Geirhos et al., 2020 ) . This distinction matters for communication because the headline metric describes predictive performance, not what evidence the model used.
blocks.zh: 医学成像数据集的高性能本身并不表明一个模型学到了临床上有意义的证据. 模型可以利用获取模式,医院身份,图像处理,文本标记,或其他与标签相关但不会转移到新设置的数据集特定特征(Zech等人,2018年;DeGrave等人,2021年). 快捷学习是一个更广泛的机器学习问题,预测器使用一种简单的相关特征,而不是任务打算衡量的机制(Geirhos等人,2020年)。 这种区分对通信很重要,因为标题衡量尺度描述了预测性能,而不是模型使用的证据。

blocks.en: Medical AI studies are especially sensitive to small test sets, leakage, data reuse, class imbalance, and unstable model rankings ( Varoquaux and Cheplygina, 2022 ; Roberts et al., 2021 ) . Related benchmark studies show that duplicates can change rankings and that newly collected test sets can reveal drops that were hidden by the original evaluation ( Barz and Denzler, 2020 ; Recht et al., 2019 ) . These observations motivate our controlled comparison of architecture effects with protocol effects in Eq. 3 . We also audit duplicates separately because contamination and distribution shift can produce superficially similar performance patterns.
blocks.zh: 医学AI研究对小型测试集,渗漏,数据再利用,阶级不平衡,以及不稳定的模型排名特别敏感(Varoquaux和Cheplygina,2022年;Roberts等人,2021年). 相关基准研究表明,重复可以改变排名,新收集的测试集可以揭示被原始评价所隐藏的下降(Barz and Denzler, 2020; Recht et al., 2019). 这些观察促使我们对建筑效果和Eq. 3中的协议效果进行有控制的比较。 我们还单独审计重复,因为污染和分配的转变可能产生表面相似的业绩模式。

blocks.en: AUROC measures ranking over thresholds, but a decision system eventually operates at one threshold and presents confidence values that users may interpret as probabilities. Youden’s index is a standard way to choose an operating point when sensitivity and specificity are weighted equally ( Youden, 1950 ) . Temperature scaling is a standard post hoc calibration method that often improves confidence estimates on data drawn from the same distribution as the validation set ( Guo et al., 2017 ) . When validation and test distributions differ, however, the chosen threshold and calibration map may not transfer. This is important in medical AI because a model can preserve ranking performance while producing poorly chosen decisions or misleading confidence values ( Liu et al., 2022a ) .
blocks.zh: AUROC衡量阈值的排名,但决策系统最终在一个阈值上运行,并呈现出用户可能解释为概率的信任值. Youden的指数是在敏感度和特异性均匀加权时选择操作点的标准方法(Youden, 1950). 温度缩放是一种标准后特设校准方法,经常改进对从与验证集(Guo等人,2017年)相同的分布中提取的数据的置信估计. 然而,当验证和测试分布不同时,所选的阈值和校准地图可能不会转移. 这在医学AI中很重要,因为模型可以保持排名性能,同时产生选择不当的决定或误导性信心值(Liu等人,2022a). 。 。 。

blocks.en: TRIPOD+AI asks authors to describe evaluation data, discrimination, calibration, thresholds, and uncertainty for prediction model studies ( Collins et al., 2024 ) . The challenge is not only whether such information exists somewhere in a paper. The challenge is whether the performance claim that travels outside the paper retains enough context to be interpreted correctly. Our study therefore treats the benchmark score itself as a communication object and measures how much meaning is lost when the protocol around that score is omitted.
blocks.zh: TRIPOD+AI请作者描述预测模型研究的评价数据、歧视、校准、阈值和不确定性(Collins等人,2024年)。 挑战不仅在于这种信息是否存在于文件中。 挑战在于,在纸张以外旅行的履约索赔是否保留了足够的上下文,以便正确解释。 因此,我们的研究将基准分数本身视为一个通信对象,并衡量在省略该分数周围的协议时损失了多少意义。

blocks.en: The Kermany corpus contains pediatric chest radiographs labeled normal or pneumonia , distributed as 5,216 training images, 16 validation images, and 624 test images ( Kermany et al., 2018 ) . The official validation set contains only eight images per class, so it is too small for stable early stopping, threshold selection, or calibration. We therefore create a patient disjoint validation split from the released training pool and leave the official test split untouched. Filenames encode a patient or study identifier, so related images are assigned as a group. We remove exact byte level duplicates before training, yielding 4420 training images, 770 validation images, and 618 official test images. Figure 5 in Appendix D shows the split composition. A separate near duplicate audit in the same appendix checks that train to test leakage is not the explanation for the distributional effects reported in Section 4.3 .

blocks.zh: 为了测试两个分区是否可以交换,我们提取冷冻的ResNet-50特性,并训练后勤回归,以预测一个图像是来自训练池还是官方的测试分裂. 我们使用五折叠的折叠预测,并在打乱分区标签后重复分析. 除了歧视者AUC之外,我们报告代理人A\mathcal{A}距离(Ben-David等人,2010年):d A=2(1-2 ), =分区分类器的均衡错误. d_{\mathcal{A}}=2(1-2\epsilon),\quad\epsilon{text{分区分类器的平衡错误}。 (6)接近0的值意味着分区很难区分,而接近2的值则意味着它们很容易分离. 我们重复我们自己列车的程序 和验证分区作为控制。

blocks.en: We train a gradient boosted tree using only file properties: pixel dimensions, aspect ratio, file size, bytes per pixel, image mode, and JPEG quantization tables. It receives no image pixels and no anatomical features. We first evaluate it with five fold cross validation inside the training pool, then fit it on that pool and evaluate it on the untouched official test split. A large drop between these two evaluations would show that file construction artifacts encode the label within one partition but do not transfer to the official test set.

Confidence intervals for AUROC are obtained by percentile bootstrap resampling of test cases with 2,000 resamples, and paired AUROC differences are tested using DeLong’s method ( DeLong et al., 1988 ) . Precision-recall curves and AUPRC are also reported because class imbalance can make precision-recall summaries more informative than ROC summaries for some comparisons ( Saito and Rehmsmeier, 2015 ) . blocks.en: 4.1 Architecture differences are small relative to several protocol effects
blocks.zh: 4.1 与若干协议效果相比,结构差异很小

blocks.en: Under the reference protocol π 0 \pi_{0} , the eight pretrained architectures occupy a narrow AUROC range of 0.026. Their bootstrap intervals overlap substantially in Figure 1 a, and the paired DeLong analysis in Appendix C shows that most pairwise differences are not distinguishable at this test set size. The custom CNN trained from scratch is clearly weaker, but the ordering among the pretrained backbones should not be read as a stable leaderboard.
blocks.zh: 根据参考协议 ^0\pi_{0},8个预训架构占据了0.026的窄AUROC范围. 在图1a中,它们的靴子间隔大为重叠,附录C中配对的DeLong分析显示,在这个测试集大小上,大多数配对差异是无法区分的。 从零开始训练的定制CNN显然较弱,但预训骨干中的订单不应被解读为稳定的领航板.

With 618 test images after exact duplicate removal, the 95% bootstrap interval is roughly ± 0.02 \pm 0.02 AUROC for individual models. This means that reporting a score to three decimal places without an interval can communicate more precision than the benchmark supports. In the notation of Eq. 3 , Δ arch = 0.026 \Delta_{\mathrm{arch}}=0.026 is the reference against which we compare the protocol effects below.

blocks.en: 4.2 Backbone training changes the conclusion more than architecture choice
blocks.zh: 4.2 背骨培训改变结论多于结构选择

blocks.en: Changing ϕ \phi from a frozen feature extractor to full fine tuning changes AUROC by 0.044 on average across the eight pretrained architectures and by as much as 0.103. Both values are larger than the 0.026 architectural spread defined above. Figure 1 b also shows that the sign of the change is not constant. Some models improve after fine tuning, while others change little or lose balanced accuracy, so a ranking obtained under one backbone training policy cannot simply be transferred to the other.
blocks.zh: 将 &\phi 从一个冷冻特性提取器改为全微调换成AUROC,平均在8个预先训练的架构中修改0.044,并达到0.103. 这两个数值都大于上面定义的0.026建筑分布. 图1b还显示变化的标志不是不变的. 一些模型在微调后有所改进,而另一些则变化不大或失去平衡的准确性,因此在一个骨干培训政策下获得的排名不能简单地转移到另一个.

blocks.en: This comparison is intentionally simple because the communication failure is simple. Two papers can name the same architecture but train it in materially different ways. If the backbone training policy is absent from the headline comparison, a reader may attribute a difference to architecture design when it is partly or mainly a protocol effect. Appendix Table 5 provides the per architecture values for balanced accuracy, F 1 F_{1} , and AUROC.
blocks.zh: 这种比较是故意简单的,因为通信故障是简单的. 两篇论文可以命名相同的建筑,但以实质上不同的方式对其进行训练. 如果主干线培训政策没有出现在标题比较中,读者可能会在部分或主要是协议效果时将差异归因于架构设计. 附录表5提供了每个结构的平衡准确性值,F 1 F_{1}和AUROC。

blocks.en: 4.3 The official test split is measurably different from the training pool
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 正式的测试分拆 与训练池有很大不同

blocks.en: The partition classifier separates the training pool from the official test split at AUC 0.697, compared with 0.503 after shuffling partition labels. The shift is not uniform across classes. For normal radiographs, partition AUC rises to 0.898, while for pneumonia it is 0.664. Applying Eq. 6 gives a proxy 𝒜 \mathcal{A} distance of 1.226 for the normal class, compared with 0.117 for our own patient disjoint train and validation split. Figure 2 a makes this contrast visible, and Appendix Table 8 gives the corresponding proxy 𝒜 \mathcal{A} distances.
blocks.zh: 分区分类器将训练池与正式测试分开,在AUC 0.697分,而打乱分区标签后的0.503分. 班级间轮班不统一. 对于普通的放射图,分区AUC上升至0.898,而对于肺炎则上升至0.664. 应用 Eq. 6 给出的代理值 A\ mathcal{A} 正常等级的距离为1.226, 而我们自己的病人脱节列车和验证分拆为0. 117 。 图2 a使这种对比明显可见,附录表8给出了相应的代理 A\ mathcal{A}距离.

blocks.en: Two controls make the interpretation more specific. First, the same partition classifier applied to our train and validation partitions reaches only 0.542, which is close to chance. Second, the duplicate audit in Appendix D finds no test image with a near twin in the training pool at the primary similarity threshold. These checks make simple duplication an unlikely explanation. The official test split therefore behaves as a small transfer set rather than as an exchangeable sample from the training pool.
blocks.zh: 两个控制使解释更加具体. 第一,适用于我国列车的同一分区分类器和验证分区只达到0.542,这几乎是偶然的. 第二,附录D中的重复审计发现,在初级相似度阈值的训练池中,没有带有近双子的测试图像。 这些检查使简单的重复成为不可能的解释。 因此,正式测试的分裂表现为一个小的调剂组,而不是培训池的可交换样本。

blocks.en: We cannot identify the source of the shift because the released metadata do not contain the acquisition and curation information needed to do so. Similar hidden acquisition and site effects are well documented in medical imaging datasets ( Zech et al., 2018 ; Oakden-Rayner, 2020 ) . Our claim is therefore limited to what the experiment establishes: the partitions are distinguishable, the difference is strongest for normal images, and post hoc choices fitted on the training distribution should not be assumed to transfer unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们无法确定转移的来源,因为公布的元数据没有包含获取和整理所需的信息。 医学成像数据集中也详细记载了类似的隐藏获取和现场效应(Zech等人,2018年;Oakden-Rayner,2020年). 因此,我们的说法仅限于试验所证实的内容:分区是可区分的,差异对正常图像最强,在训练分发上安装的后期选择不应假定不变转移.

blocks.en: (a) Partition distinguishability. The dashed line marks chance AUC.
blocks.zh: (a) 可区分性。 虚线标志着AUC的机会。

blocks.en: (b) File only label prediction across split policies.
blocks.zh: (b) 仅对分散政策进行标签预测。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Evidence that split policy changes what the benchmark measures. Panel (a) shows that the official test split is distinguishable from the training pool, especially for normal radiographs, while the study’s own train and validation partitions are much closer to chance. Panel (b) shows that file properties alone nearly solve the label task inside the training pool but fail on the untouched official test split. Together, these results explain why pooling and randomly re-splitting the released data can preserve a shortcut that does not transfer.
blocks.zh: 图2:政策分裂的证据改变了基准衡量标准。 小组(a) 显示,正式的测试分拆与培训池是分不开的,特别是普通的射电图,而研究本身的列车和验证分区更接近于机会。 面板(b)显示,仅文件属性就几乎解决了训练池内的标签任务,但在未触及的官方测试拆分上失败了. 这些结果共同解释了为什么集合和随机重分配所释放的数据可以保存一个不传输的快捷键.

blocks.en: 4.4 A file only predictor shows why pooling and re-splitting can be misleading
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 仅一个文件预测器显示为什么集合和重分享会误导

blocks.en: The file only classifier makes the split problem easy to see. It uses image dimensions, file size, bytes per pixel, image mode, and JPEG quantization information, but no radiograph pixels and therefore no anatomy. Within the training pool it predicts the diagnosis at 0.992 balanced accuracy under five fold cross validation. When fitted on that pool and evaluated on the untouched official test split, balanced accuracy falls to 0.496, which is essentially chance. Figure 2 b shows this collapse next to the partition shift result so that the two pieces of evidence can be read together.
blocks.zh: 文件只分类器使拆分问题容易看到. 它使用图像维度,文件大小,每个像素的字节,图像模式,以及JPEG的量化信息,但没有放射图像素,因此也没有解剖学. 在训练池内,它预测诊断结果在五折交叉验证下为0.992平衡精度. 如果安装在该池上并按未触动的官方测试分数进行评估,平衡的准确度降至0.496,这基本上是偶然的。 图2b显示在分区偏移结果旁边的这个坍塌,这样两个证据可以一起阅读.

blocks.en: The result should not be interpreted as evidence that file headers cause pneumonia. It shows that the two labels in the training pool were stored or processed in systematically different ways. Those construction artifacts provide an easy shortcut inside that pool, but the shortcut does not survive the move to the official test split. This pattern is consistent with the broader shortcut learning literature, where nonclinical acquisition signals can support apparently strong within dataset performance ( DeGrave et al., 2021 ; Geirhos et al., 2020 ) .
blocks.zh: 结果不应被解释为文件头引起肺炎的证据。 这表明训练池中的两个标签是用系统不同的方式存储或处理的. 这些建筑文物在该游泳池内提供了一条容易的捷径,但捷径却无法在进入正式测试分裂的过程中幸存下来. 这种模式与更广泛的快捷学习文献一致,其中非临床获取信号可以在数据集性能中明显支持强(DeGrave等人,2021年;Geirhos等人,2020年).

blocks.en: This directly explains why split policy σ \sigma is part of the reported score in Eq. 1 . If the released partitions are pooled and randomly re-split, train and test examples can share the same file level signature. The resulting evaluation may reward regularities that disappear on the official split. The pair 0.992 within the training pool and 0.496 on the official test set provides a concrete measured example of how a seemingly small evaluation decision can change the story attached to a high score.
blocks.zh: 这直接解释了为什么将政策划分为\sigma作为Eq.1中报告分数的一部分。 如果释放的分区被集合和随机重拆,列车和测试实例可以共享相同的文件级别签名. 由此产生的评价可能奖励在正式分裂中消失的规律性。 训练池内的配对0.992和正式测试集上的0.496提供了一个具体衡量的例子,说明看似小的评价决定如何改变附在高分上的故事.

blocks.en: 4.5 Thresholds and calibration fitted on validation do not fully transfer
blocks.zh: 4.5 在审定时安装的阈值和校准不完全转让

blocks.en: The decision threshold is another large protocol effect. Moving from the default t = 0.5 t=0.5 to the validation selected t ⋆ t^{\star} in Eq. 4 changes balanced accuracy by 0.090 on average, which is larger than Δ arch \Delta_{\mathrm{arch}} . The full per architecture comparison is in Appendix Table 6 . Figure 3 a gives the case count view for the strongest model and shows why the threshold must be reported together with any label based metric.
blocks.zh: 决定阈值是另一个巨大的协议效应. 从默认 t = 0.5 t = 0.5 到 Eq 4 中选择的 t = t = star } 的验证中,平均以 0.090 修改平衡精度,该精度大于 Q 拱 = Delta = mathrm{arch }. 附录表6为每个建筑的完整比较。 图3 a给出了最强模型的个案计数视图,并表明为什么阈值必须与任何基于标签的衡量标准一起报告。

blocks.en: Validation tuning does not remove the entire operating point problem. Choosing the threshold directly on the test labels, which is an invalid oracle used only to measure the gap, improves balanced accuracy by a further 0.083 on average. The target prevalence rule in Eq. 7 is a sensitivity analysis that does not use target labels. In the aggregate experiment it raises balanced accuracy from 0.787 to 0.863, compared with the unattainable test oracle of 0.870, recovering 92% of that specific gap. Appendix Table 7 reports these values. We do not propose this as a general deployment rule because it depends on a credible external prevalence estimate. We include it to show that the failure is connected to the target distribution rather than to a lack of threshold optimization.
blocks.zh: 校验调音不能消除整个操作点问题. 直接在测试标签上选择阈值,是一种无效的甲骨文,仅用于测量缺口,可以进一步提高平均0.083的平衡精度. Eq. 7中的目标普及规则是一种不使用目标标签的敏感性分析. 在综合实验中,它将平衡精度从0.787提高到0.863,而不可达到的试验甲骨文为0.870,恢复了该具体差距的92%。 附录表7报告了这些数值。 我们不提议将此作为一般部署规则,因为它取决于可靠的外部流行率估计。 我们把它包括在内是为了表明故障与目标分布有关,而不是缺乏阈值优化.

blocks.en: Calibration shows a related transfer problem. Using Eq. 5 , mean test ECE changes only from 0.172 before calibration to 0.169 after applying a temperature fitted on validation data, and ECE becomes worse in 9 of 26 runs. The mean fitted temperature is 1.41, and T ⋆ < 1 T^{\star}<1 occurs in 9 runs, so the direction of the fitted correction is not consistent across models. Figure 3 b shows the corresponding reliability diagram for ViT-B/16, while Appendix Table 8 provides the Brier decomposition. The conclusion is not that temperature scaling is ineffective in general. It is that the phrase “the model was calibrated” is incomplete unless the paper states where calibration was fitted and where it was evaluated.
blocks.zh: 校准显示相关的传输问题. 采用Eq. 5, 欧洲经委会平均试验从校准前的0.172改为在验证数据上适用温度后的0.169,欧洲经委会在26次运行中的9次变得更加糟糕。 安装的平均温度为1.41,T < 1 T^{\star}<1在9次运行中出现,因此安装校正的方向不同型号不一致. 图3b显示了相应的VIT-B/16可靠性图,附录表8提供了Brier分解图. 得出的结论并不是温度的缩放一般是无效的. “该型号被校准”一语是不完全的,除非该文件说明校准的装配地点和评估地点。

Panel (b) shows that a temperature fitted on validation data changes confidence estimates but does not remove the calibration gap on the official test distribution.

blocks.en: 5 From a Benchmark Score to a Responsible Claim
blocks.zh: 5 从基准分数到责任索赔

blocks.en: Table 3 places two published results beside our evaluation to show how different protocols can sit behind similar headline numbers. Stephen et al. ( Stephen et al., 2019 ) report 0.937 accuracy after pooling and re-splitting the data, while Kundu et al. ( Kundu et al., 2021 ) report 0.988 accuracy under pooled cross validation. Our rows preserve the official test split. Because split policy, metric, model training, and operating point differ, these values answer different questions rather than forming one valid ranking. Equation 2 makes those differences explicit.

blocks.en: Table 3 : Examples of reported results on the same dataset under different evaluation setups. These rows should not be read as a model ranking: the split and metric differ across studies. “Pooled” means that images were combined and re-partitioned rather than evaluated on the untouched official test split.

blocks.en: The measured effects in Table 2 suggest a compact reporting rule. A biomedical benchmark result should state the evaluation split, whether pretrained features were frozen or fine tuned, the decision threshold and how it was selected, a metric that exposes class imbalance, how and where calibration was fitted, uncertainty or an appropriate paired comparison, and a basic train to test shift check when practical. These are not stylistic preferences. Each item corresponds to an effect measured in Sections 4.1 to 4.5 .
blocks.zh: 表2中衡量的效果表明,报告规则是紧凑的。 生物医学基准结果应说明评价的分化情况,是预先训练的特征被冻结还是调整精细,决定阈值和选择方法,揭示班级不平衡、校准方式和地点、不确定性还是适当的对等比较,以及在实际可行时测试班次检查的基本列车。 这些不是形式上的偏好。 每个项目对应于第4.1至4.5节衡量的效果。

blocks.en: This recommendation is consistent with the broader goals of TRIPOD+AI ( Collins et al., 2024 ) , but our point is narrower: the cost of missing protocol details can be measured on the benchmark itself. Here, backbone training changes AUROC more than the pretrained architecture spread, threshold selection changes balanced accuracy by even more, the file only shortcut falls from 0.992 to 0.496 across split policies, and the official test partition is measurably different from the training pool.
blocks.zh: 这项建议符合TRIPOD+AI(Collins等人,2024年)的更广泛目标,但我们的观点比较狭隘:缺失协议细节的成本可以用基准本身来衡量. 在这里,骨干训练比预先训练的架构扩展更能改变AUROC,阈值选择更能改变均衡的准确性,文件只通过分割政策从0.992降至0.496,官方的测试分区与训练池有相当大的区别.

blocks.en: Appendix F provides a supplementary Grad-CAM ( Selvaraju et al., 2017 ) and SHAP ( Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ) audit. We summarize attribution mass outside a body mask rather than treating a heatmap as a causal explanation. This analysis is separate from the protocol results, but it illustrates the same communication limit: a strong discrimination score does not reveal whether the visual evidence used by a model is clinically meaningful.
blocks.zh: 附 录 F提供了Grad-CAM(Selvaraju等人,2017年)和SHAP(Lundberg and Lee,2017年)的补充审计. 我们总结身体面具外的归属质量,而不是将热图作为因果解释. 这种分析与协议结果是分开的,但它说明了同样的通信极限:强烈的区别分数并不能揭示模型使用的视觉证据在临床上是否有意义.

blocks.en: The strongest supported claim is that modern pretrained image classifiers separate the two released labels well on the official split under a stated protocol. The experiments do not establish cross hospital generalization, clinical utility, readiness for triage, or meaningful superiority of one closely clustered pretrained architecture over another. Because the official split also contains an undocumented distribution difference, a responsible summary should report the score together with the split, metric, threshold, uncertainty, and observed shift.
blocks.zh: 最强支持的说法是,现代的预先训练的图像分类器在声明的协议下将官方拆分上的两个释放好的标签分开. 实验没有建立跨医院的泛化,临床效用,分解准备,或者一个紧密集群的预先训练的建筑比另一个建筑具有有意义的优越性. 由于官方的拆分也包含一个无证的发行差额,因此负责的汇总应该将分数与拆分,度量,阈值,不确定性和观察到的转变一起报告.

blocks.en: The failure occurs when a precise result is shortened into a claim that drops the protocol needed to interpret it. Table 2 shows the remedy: keep those technical conditions attached to the result by expressing them as measured changes in the reported score.
blocks.zh: 失败发生在将确切结果缩短为放弃解释协议所需协议的索赔时。 表2显示补救措施:将技术条件附在结果之后,将其表示为报告得分的衡量变化。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 限制和结论

blocks.en: This is a case study of one public pediatric radiograph dataset, not a survey of biomedical benchmarks. The released metadata do not identify the source of the train to test shift, and the file only experiment establishes a construction shortcut without proving that a particular neural network uses it. The small test set limits architecture comparisons, while the target prevalence threshold is only a sensitivity analysis because reliable prevalence may not be available at deployment. Additional robustness and reproducibility details appear in Appendices G and H .
blocks.zh: 这是一个公立儿科放射数据集的案例研究,而不是生物医学基准调查。 所发布的元数据无法识别列车测试转向的源头,而文件只建立了构建快捷键的实验,而没有证明特定神经网络使用它. 小型测试设置限制架构比较,而目标流行阈值只是一种敏感性分析,因为部署时可能无法获得可靠的流行. 附录G和H载有其他有力性和可复制性的细节。

blocks.en: A benchmark score reflects both model and protocol. Here, training, split, threshold, calibration, and shift choices affect the result as much as or more than architecture choice. Those conditions need to travel with the score.
blocks.zh: 基准分数既反映模式,也反映协议. 在这里,训练,分拆,阈值,校准,以及转向选择,都影响着结果,甚至超过架构选择. 这些条件需要随分数一起旅行.

blocks.en: Appendix H Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 附录H 可复制性

blocks.en: All reported numerical values are generated from stored per case model outputs into the LaTeX macro file used by the manuscript. The analysis stage consumes one metric record per run and one array of logits per run and split, which is sufficient to recompute metrics, operating points, confidence intervals, calibration analyses, and statistical tests without retraining. For an anonymized release, the intended artifacts are the patient disjoint split lists, per case predicted probabilities, the file only feature extractor used in Section 4.4 , the partition classifier used in Section 4.3 , and scripts that regenerate the tables and figures in this appendix. This organization keeps the numerical claims in the paper tied to reproducible analysis outputs rather than hand transcribed values.
